verdict.rationale: The Wyoming Secretary of State is a government business-filing and records portal, not an AI agent or assistant. Plugging MCP servers into it so it can use their tools is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client or agent capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
